# Alex Maywood

> Alex Maywood is a NASM certified personal trainer, Strength Coach Level 1 and certified nutrition coach. He offers 1:1 remote coaching, individually designed around each client's history, how they move and how they live, so the results last after coaching ends. The business is APEX EDGE FIT LLC.

## About

- **Who:** Alex Maywood, 1:1 remote fitness and nutrition coach.
- **Who it's for:** people who have tried diets, apps, classes and templates and are done starting over; who want to lose fat, build muscle or get stronger and are ready to give it the time it takes; and who are comfortable training on their own with remote coaching.
- **Not a fit for:** anyone looking for a quick fix, anyone who won't train on their own or do weekly check-ins, or anyone not ready to commit to at least six months.
- **Method:** AAEM, four phases.
  - **Audit** (how you live): goals, history, injuries, job, family and how you eat today. Nothing gets prescribed until the coach understands the client's life.
  - **Assess** (how you move): movement, strength, work capacity and body composition, tested instead of guessed.
  - **Engineer** (build the plan): training, nutrition and lifestyle built as one plan, foundation first, at the dose the body can handle.
  - **Mobilize** (execute and adjust): weekly check-ins, wearable data (sleep, recovery, daily movement) in every adjustment, and a monthly retest.
- **Credentials:** NASM Certified Personal Trainer; Strength Coach Level 1, Strength System International; Certified Nutrition Coach (Dr. Layne Norton's evidence-based program).
- **Also:** Co-founder of Yalla Stride, a social run club in Austin, TX. Yalla Stride is a community club, separate from Alex's 1:1 coaching.
- **Capacity:** Alex coaches 15 people at a time so he can review every check-in himself.

## Coaching options

Coaching starts with a six-month commitment.

- **Foundation:** 6 months, $450 a month. Pay in full and save $405.
- **Elite (recommended):** 12 months, $350 a month. Save up to $1,830.
- **Apex (best value):** 24 months, $300 a month. Save up to $4,680.

Savings are compared with the 6-month rate; the maximum saving includes 15% off when paying in full.

- **Every option includes:** personalized strength training program, personalized nutrition, lifestyle and habit coaching, weekly check-ins, wearable sync, monthly 30-minute video consultations, direct access by text and voice message, unlimited video form reviews, and up to 20% off supplements.
- **Guarantee:** the Right Fit Guarantee. Try it for 30 days from the day you pay; if it's not the right fit, every payment is refunded.

## How to start

1. Apply and book a 30-minute call: https://calendly.com/alex-maywood/30min
2. A no-pressure conversation to see if it's a good fit.
3. Onboarding and assessment in the coaching app (usually one to two weeks).
4. Coaching begins. It's fully remote: train on your own, check in weekly, meet monthly by video.

## Common questions

- **How much time does this take?** The plan works around the client's time and current life, built in the right order for long-term goals.
- **Do I have to follow a strict diet?** No. Nutrition works with the food you like; you learn how and when to track, without a restrictive diet.
- **How is progress tracked?** Weekly check-ins, lift progress, lifestyle metrics, body composition, progress photos and measurements, plus sleep and recovery data from a wearable.
- **What about busy weeks or travel?** The plan is reviewed weekly and adjusts to what's going on.
- **Do I need a gym?** No. The program is designed around the equipment and space available.
